_comment: The invite in pasted text (T-300, T-301): what the redeem field makes of a whole pasted
message before the token is taken out of it. ONE file, read by BOTH test suites, like
name-order.json: web/src/lib/inviteToken.test.ts imports it and Android's PastedInviteTest
reads it from the repo root.
The rule: the first https URL in the text, preferring the first one with an /invite/ segment,
with any trailing . , ; : ! ? ) ] > " ' dropped. The scheme matches in any case; http:// is
not taken. A URL runs to the first whitespace, counting the Unicode spaces too (no-break,
narrow no-break, ideographic and the rest), so both clients stop at the same character. Text
with no https URL in it (a bare token) comes back trimmed, otherwise unchanged.

cases.name: a link on its own line of a message
cases.input:
Join my list!
https://p23q.org/invite/abc.def
See you

cases.name: a link in parentheses with trailing punctuation
two links, the second with /invite/
cases.input: Get the app from https://p23q.org/app and join https://p23q.org/invite/abc.def

cases.name: a link without /invite/ is still taken when it is the only one
a link ends at a no-break space
a bare token with whitespace around it
an http:// link is not taken
